professionalSummary.text: Senior frontend engineer with proven experience delivering high-performance alert queue and case view components for compliance analysts.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed and maintained the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application (TypeScript, Angular), including the server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced the full-queue download.

professionalSummary.text: Owner of comprehensive component and end-to-end test suites, ensuring continuous pipeline stability.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.

professionalSummary.text: Demonstrated ability to reduce alert-queue load time from 6.2 s to 1.4 s, meeting and exceeding the published performance baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: Median alert-queue load time for analysts fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by the application's real-user monitoring over the following four weeks against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds.

professionalSummary.text: Collaborated closely with backend teams to coordinate API changes and adapt frontend views accordingly.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated API changes with the backend team in the API review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the views to the paged endpoints.

professionalSummary.text: Authored detailed release notes documenting known limitations and hand-over conditions for each deployment.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release notes for each application release, including the known limitation that column sorting was applied per page rather than across the whole queue, and the hand-over notes for the frontend on-call.
